name: Zaklad Budowy Maszyn ZREMB - Chojnice Spolka Akcyjna
summary: Zaklad Budowy Maszyn ZREMB - Chojnice Spolka Akcyjna, a Polish firm based in Chojnice and a subsidiary of MSX Resources SA, specializes in the production and sale of an extensive array of containers and steel fabrications. The company provides numerous container types, including robust offshore units for shipping and drilling platforms; basket containers for conveying equipment to these platforms; mini-mud freight containers for delivering supplies and provisions to platform personnel; and borekaks containers for the disposal of drilling waste. Furthermore, they manufacture specialized containers for uses such as mobile workshops, compression stations, and generators, alongside military-specific containers and platforms, and units designed for radioactive waste. In the realm of steel structures, ZREMB offers steel roof systems, frameworks for glazed exteriors, bespoke buildings and industrial facilities, and various other custom steel constructions. Their steel roof structures and facades are exported globally to countries including Germany, various Arabic nations, Turkey, Italy, Spain, the United States, Ireland, and Great Britain.
